books.title: Geometric measure theory and variational problems: a first reading
books.author: Stack Project of Geometric Measure Theory and Variational Problems contributors
books.description: Original exposition connecting classical GMT, BV compactness, coarea, level-set calculus and perimeter minimization, current operations, Plateau existence, calibrated currents and singular complex curves, subcalibrations and minimizing Simons cones, smooth-support varifold constancy, exact stationary and bounded-curvature monotonicity, tangent-cone homogeneity, spine splitting, support convergence, qualitative stratification, and balanced junctions, minimal surfaces, elliptic and Allard regularity, scalar curvature and stability, Bernstein and smooth-link cone theorems, min-max theory, the volume spectrum, CMC variations and stability, Minkowski identities, constrained Jacobi fields and spectral tests, Euclidean and spherical CMC rigidity, and Allen-Cahn transition profiles, BV phase compactness, perimeter lower bounds, equipartition, recovery layers, variational limits, gradient bounds and energy monotonicity, stability, and monotone-solution rigidity. Mean curvature flow includes evolution, comparison, Gaussian monotonicity, entropy, rescaling, Brakke flow, weighted shrinker identities, Gaussian variations, symmetry modes, center/scale stability, Gaussian tails and convergence, entropy maximizers, translation factors, and entropy-lowering perturbations. Classical obstacle theory includes variational existence, reaction measures, quadratic blow-ups, Weiss and Monneau monotonicity, and singular blow-up uniqueness. Exact source editions, hypotheses, and proof status are recorded.
